faq.title: Common Questions
faq.q1: How long does a typical project take?
faq.a1: A landing page or chatbot can be done in 1–2 weeks. Company profiles and basic apps take 2–4 weeks. Larger builds (custom web apps, AI systems, or multi-platform products) typically run 6–12 weeks depending on scope.
faq.q2: Can you work with our existing codebase?
faq.a2: Yes. We regularly audit, refactor, and extend existing projects. We can also integrate AI features into systems that are already in production.
faq.a3: You do. All source code, designs, database schemas, and AI configurations are transferred to you upon project completion and final payment.
faq.a4: Standard structure: 50% upfront to begin, 25% at mid-project review, and 25% before production deployment. We're flexible for ongoing retainer engagements.
faq.q5: Are AI API costs included in the project price?
faq.a5: No. Development cost covers building and deploying the system. Ongoing API costs (OpenAI, Claude, etc.) are billed directly to your own account, typically $15–$125/month depending on usage. We help you set this up and optimize costs.
faq.q6: What if my project doesn't fit any of these categories?
faq.a6: Most projects are a combination of services. Just tell us what you need during the scoping call and we'll put together a custom proposal with a clear breakdown.
